_note: Schedules MCP tools (2026-10-20 extension pack). core.mjs TOOLS shape. Occurrences served only when fresh (checked within TTL) and future; otherwise the official schedule_url with a confirm badge.

tools.description: Retreats and courses by country, tradition, length or format: stable programmes plus fresh dated occurrences (each with checked date and the official schedule link). Stale or expired instances never appear — the tool says when each item was last confirmed.

country.description: ISO code, e.g. GB, US, TH, LK

tradition.description: tradition id, e.g. thai-forest, mahasi, gelug

tools.name: find_retreats
tools.resolver: programmes filtered by place.country/traditions + occurrences WHERE startsAt > now AND checked within TTL, ordered by startsAt; each item carries checked + schedule_url
tools.title: Find retreats

tools.description: One place's full schedule: its programmes, fresh occurrences, and the official schedule page (canonical — always cite it for dates). Includes the last-checked date so callers show staleness honestly.
tools.name: get_schedule
tools.resolver: place + programmes + fresh occurrences + schedule_url + checked; stale rows carry confirm-on-official-page badge
tools.title: Place schedule
